<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>About OnSpot — Work Without Limits</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:wght@500;600;700;800&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --purple:#474EAD;
    --purple-dark:#383E8C;
    --purple-deep:#2E3170;
    --purple-tint:#EEEDFB;
    --purple-tint-2:#E1DFF7;
    --gold:#F5A623;
    --gold-tint:#FDF1DE;
    --gold-tint-2:#FBE4BC;
    --charcoal:#1D1D1F;
    --gray-700:#46464C;
    --gray-500:#7A7A82;
    --gray-300:#D8D8DE;
    --line:#E9E9EF;
    --paper:#FDFCFA;
    --paper-2:#F7F7FA;
    --max:1120px;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  body{margin:0;font-family:'Inter',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif;background:var(--paper);color:var(--charcoal);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;}
  h1,h2,h3{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque',sans-serif;margin:0;letter-spacing:-0.02em;}
  p{margin:0;}
  a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;}
  img{display:block;max-width:100%;}
  .wrap{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 32px;}

  /* NAV */
  .nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:60;background:var(--purple);}
  .nav .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:72px;}
  .nav-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:44px;}
  .logo-img{height:28px;width:auto;}
  .nav-links{display:flex;gap:8px;}
  .nav-links a{font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:rgba(255,255,255,.72);padding:8px 14px;border-radius:8px;transition:color .15s ease,background .15s ease;}
  .nav-links a:hover{color:#fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);}
  .nav-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;}
  .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;padding:11px 20px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .12s ease,background .15s ease;}
  .btn:active{transform:scale(.97);}
  .btn-ghost-onpurple{color:#fff;background:transparent;}
  .btn-ghost-onpurple:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);}
  .btn-white{background:#fff;color:var(--purple);}
  .btn-primary{background:var(--purple);color:#fff;}
  .btn-primary:hover{background:var(--purple-dark);}
  .btn-outline{background:transparent;color:var(--purple);border-color:var(--purple);}
  .btn-outline:hover{background:var(--purple-tint);}
  .btn-sm{padding:9px 16px;font-size:13px;}

  /* KICKER */
  .kicker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--purple);margin-bottom:16px;}
  .kicker::before{content:"";width:16px;height:2px;background:var(--purple);border-radius:2px;}

  /* HERO */
  .hero{position:relative;padding:110px 0 90px;text-align:center;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 20%, rgba(71,78,173,.10), transparent 60%);}
  .hero h1{font-size:clamp(38px,5.6vw,62px);font-weight:700;line-height:1.08;max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;}
  .hero .sub{font-size:18px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--gray-700);max-width:560px;margin:22px auto 0;}

  /* ORIGIN */
  .origin{padding:96px 0;background:var(--paper-2);}
  .origin .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:64px;align-items:center;}
  .origin h2{font-size:clamp(26px,3.2vw,36px);line-height:1.2;margin-bottom:20px;}
  .origin p{font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.75;color:var(--gray-700);margin-bottom:14px;}
  .quote-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:32px 30px;}
  .quote-card blockquote{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque',sans-serif;font-size:19px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.5;color:var(--charcoal);margin:0 0 20px;}
  .quote-attribution{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;}
  .quote-avatar{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;flex-shrink:0;}
  .quote-name{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--charcoal);}
  .quote-role{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--gray-500);}

  /* BELIEFS */
  .beliefs{padding:96px 0;text-align:center;}
  .beliefs-head{max-width:640px;margin:0 auto 56px;}
  .beliefs-head h2{font-size:clamp(26px,3.2vw,36px);line-height:1.2;}
  .belief-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px;text-align:left;}
  .belief-card{background:var(--paper-2);border-radius:16px;padding:30px 26px;}
  .belief-card .num{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque',sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:14px;}
  .belief-card p{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque',sans-serif;font-size:18px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.4;color:var(--charcoal);}

  /* CULTURE & VALUES */
  .culture{padding:96px 0;background:var(--paper-2);}
  .culture-head{max-width:640px;margin:0 auto 24px;text-align:center;}
  .culture-head h2{font-size:clamp(26px,3.2vw,36px);line-height:1.2;}
  .culture-intro{max-width:680px;margin:0 auto 56px;text-align:center;font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.75;color:var(--gray-700);}
  .values-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;}
  .value-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:26px 24px;}
  .value-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--purple);margin-bottom:16px;}
  .value-card:nth-child(2) .value-dot,.value-card:nth-child(4) .value-dot{background:var(--gold);}
  .value-name{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque',sans-serif;font-size:16.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--charcoal);margin-bottom:8px;}
  .value-desc{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--gray-700);}

  .subgroup-label{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--gray-500);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;margin-bottom:18px;text-align:center;}
  .values-grid + .subgroup-label{margin-top:56px;}
  .values-grid.cols-2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}

  /* LEADERSHIP */
  .leadership{padding:96px 0;background:var(--paper);text-align:center;}
  .leadership-head{max-width:560px;margin:0 auto 56px;}
  .leadership-head h2{font-size:clamp(26px,3.2vw,36px);}
  .team-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px;}
  .team-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:32px 24px;text-align:center;}
  .team-photo{width:84px;height:84px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;margin:0 auto 18px;}
  .team-initials{width:84px;height:84px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--purple-tint);color:var(--purple);font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:24px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:0 auto 18px;}
  .team-name{font-size:17px;font-weight:700;color:var(--charcoal);font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque',sans-serif;margin-bottom:4px;}
  .team-role{font-size:13px;color:var(--gray-500);margin-bottom:14px;}
  .team-bio{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--gray-700);}

  /* VISION */
  .vision{padding:100px 0;text-align:center;background:var(--paper-2);}
  .vision-head{max-width:620px;margin:0 auto 56px;}
  .vision-head h2{font-size:clamp(26px,3.2vw,36px);line-height:1.2;}
  .vision-head p{margin-top:16px;font-size:15.5px;color:var(--gray-700);line-height:1.65;}
  .vision-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;text-align:left;}
  .voutcome{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:28px 26px;}
  .voutcome-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);margin-bottom:16px;}
  .voutcome:nth-child(2n) .voutcome-dot{background:var(--purple);}
  .voutcome-name{font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque',sans-serif;font-size:17px;font-weight:700;color:var(--charcoal);margin-bottom:8px;}
  .voutcome-desc{font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--gray-700);}

  /* CLOSING */
  .final{background:var(--purple-deep);padding:100px 0 84px;text-align:center;color:#fff;}
  .final h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.8vw,42px);margin-bottom:14px;}
  .final p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);font-size:16px;max-width:440px;margin:0 auto 32px;}
  .hero-ctas{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;}

  @media (max-width:900px){
    .origin .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:36px;}
    .belief-row,.team-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .vision-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<nav class="nav">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="nav-left">
      <img class="logo-img" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="OnSpot">
      <div class="nav-links">
        <a href="#">Hire talent</a>
        <a href="#">Find work</a>
        <a href="#">About</a>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="nav-right">
      <a class="btn btn-ghost-onpurple btn-sm" href="#">Log in</a>
      <a class="btn btn-white btn-sm" href="#">Sign up</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</nav>

<section class="hero">
  <div class="wrap">
    <span class="kicker" style="justify-content:center;">About OnSpot</span>
    <h1>Built by people who lived the problem.</h1>
    <p class="sub">OnSpot exists because we ran the old model ourselves — and watched it fail the people it was supposed to serve.</p>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="origin">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div>
      <span class="kicker">Why we exist</span>
      <h2>We didn't start with a pitch deck. We started with a failure.</h2>
      <p>For nearly two decades, our team built and ran traditional BPO operations — the management layers, the client accounts, the billing structures that everyone in the industry just accepts as "how it's done."</p>
      <p>We saw the model from the inside: clients paying for overhead they never asked for. Talented people underpaid for work that mattered. When that structure eventually broke down — clients leaving because of the very layers we were selling them — we didn't patch it. We rebuilt from scratch.</p>
      <p>OnSpot is what came out the other side: a system clients and talent both actually want, built by people who've been stuck in the one that came before it.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="quote-card">
      <blockquote>"We've watched good companies get stuck choosing between marketplace chaos and outsourcing overhead — and good talent get squeezed by both sides of that same trade-off. So we built OnSpot the way operators build things — not software developers guessing at the problem from the outside."</blockquote>
      <div class="quote-attribution">
        <img class="quote-avatar" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Nur Laminero">
        <div>
          <div class="quote-name">Nur Laminero</div>
          <div class="quote-role">Co-Founder &amp; CEO</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="beliefs">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="beliefs-head">
      <span class="kicker" style="justify-content:center;">What we believe</span>
      <h2>Not a marketplace. Not a BPO. Something we built in between.</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="belief-row">
      <div class="belief-card">
        <div class="num">01</div>
        <p>We don't create savings by paying talent less. We create savings by taking less in between.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="belief-card">
        <div class="num">02</div>
        <p>Talent sets the rate. Talent keeps the rate. Clients pay the rate, plus one transparent fee.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="belief-card">
        <div class="num">03</div>
        <p>One system to hire, manage, and pay people who actually show up — for both sides of the table.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="culture">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="culture-head">
      <span class="kicker" style="justify-content:center;">Culture</span>
      <h2>High trust. High accountability. Low politics.</h2>
    </div>
    <p class="culture-intro">We hire slowly and coach continuously — but we don't carry people who aren't pulling their weight. Everyone here owns their piece of the system, end to end. We're not building a company of employees waiting for instructions; we're building a company of people who notice what's broken and fix it before they're asked to.</p>

    <div class="subgroup-label">How we operate</div>
    <div class="values-grid">
      <div class="value-card">
        <div class="value-dot"></div>
        <div class="value-name">Customer First</div>
        <div class="value-desc">Every decision starts with what's actually good for the client or the talent on the other end — not what's easiest for us.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="value-card">
        <div class="value-dot"></div>
        <div class="value-name">Extreme Ownership</div>
        <div class="value-desc">If something's broken, we fix it. We don't wait for someone else to notice, or for it to become someone else's problem.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="value-card">
        <div class="value-dot"></div>
        <div class="value-name">Raise the Standard</div>
        <div class="value-desc">"Good enough for a traditional BPO" isn't good enough for us. We built this because the old bar was too low.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="value-card">
        <div class="value-dot"></div>
        <div class="value-name">Keep It Simple</div>
        <div class="value-desc">One system, not five tools. If it needs a manual to explain, we've already made it too complicated.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="value-card">
        <div class="value-dot"></div>
        <div class="value-name">Move Fast</div>
        <div class="value-desc">Speed is a feature. We'd rather ship something real and improve it than wait for it to be perfect.</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="subgroup-label">How we grow our people</div>
    <div class="values-grid cols-2">
      <div class="value-card">
        <div class="value-dot"></div>
        <div class="value-name">Build Leaders, Not Employees</div>
        <div class="value-desc">We're not looking for people who wait for instructions. We're building people who could run their own piece of this company.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="value-card">
        <div class="value-dot"></div>
        <div class="value-name">Hire Slowly, Only A-Players</div>
        <div class="value-desc">One wrong hire costs more than an empty seat. We'd rather wait for the right person than fill a role fast.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="value-card">
        <div class="value-dot"></div>
        <div class="value-name">Reward Initiative Over Tenure</div>
        <div class="value-desc">What gets rewarded here is who solves the problem — not who's been here the longest.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="value-card">
        <div class="value-dot"></div>
        <div class="value-name">Work Hard, Live Well</div>
        <div class="value-desc">Ambition and burnout aren't the same thing. We push hard because we care about the outcome — not to prove we can suffer for it. Good work and a good life aren't in competition here.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="leadership">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="leadership-head">
      <span class="kicker" style="justify-content:center;">Leadership</span>
      <h2>The people building it.</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="team-row">
      <div class="team-card">
        <img class="team-photo" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Nur Laminero">
        <div class="team-name">Nur Laminero</div>
        <div class="team-role">Co-Founder &amp; CEO</div>
        <div class="team-bio">Nearly 20 years running BPO operations and startups before building the system that replaces them.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="team-card">
        <img class="team-photo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Jake Wainberg">
        <div class="team-name">Jake Wainberg</div>
        <div class="team-role">Founder &amp; President</div>
        <div class="team-bio">20 years building startups in New York before leading growth and business development globally for OnSpot.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="team-card">
        <div class="team-initials">MA</div>
        <div class="team-name">Mark Apostol</div>
        <div class="team-role">Co-Founder &amp; COO</div>
        <div class="team-bio">20+ years of experience in the BPO industry and operating startups before running global operations for OnSpot.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="vision">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="vision-head">
      <span class="kicker" style="justify-content:center;">Where we're headed</span>
      <h2>Work Without Limits, at scale.</h2>
      <p>Growth isn't the goal. It's what growth lets us do for the people who actually use this — more roles covered, faster matches, and a system that gets better for everyone the bigger it gets.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="vision-grid">
      <div class="voutcome">
        <div class="voutcome-dot"></div>
        <div class="voutcome-name">Any role, anywhere</div>
        <div class="voutcome-desc">As more talent joins, whatever role you need to fill — not just the categories we started with — becomes something we can match, fast.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="voutcome">
        <div class="voutcome-dot"></div>
        <div class="voutcome-name">A growing bench of proven talent</div>
        <div class="voutcome-desc">Every completed engagement adds to a real track record. As OnSpot grows, clients get access to a deeper pool of talent with verified performance history — not just a profile and a hope.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="voutcome">
        <div class="voutcome-dot"></div>
        <div class="voutcome-name">Faster matches, not slower</div>
        <div class="voutcome-desc">More people on one system means better matches over time, not more noise. Growth should make this easier — not harder.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="voutcome">
        <div class="voutcome-dot"></div>
        <div class="voutcome-name">OnSpot Plus</div>
        <div class="voutcome-desc">Every person who joins OnSpot adds to the group buying power behind OnSpot Plus — real savings on things like health coverage and insurance, at rates individuals can't get on their own.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="voutcome">
        <div class="voutcome-dot"></div>
        <div class="voutcome-name">OnSpot Loyalty</div>
        <div class="voutcome-desc">OnSpot Loyalty rewards what actually matters — performance, tenure, and the value you bring — not just how long you've been around.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="voutcome">
        <div class="voutcome-dot"></div>
        <div class="voutcome-name">The same standard, at any size</div>
        <div class="voutcome-desc">No matter how big this gets, vetting stays real and the fee stays transparent. Scale means more people getting the same deal — not a worse one.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="final">
  <div class="wrap">
    <h2>Ready to work without limits?</h2>
    <p>Join the companies and talent already building this with us.</p>
    <div class="hero-ctas">
      <button class="btn btn-primary">Hire talent →</button>
      <button class="btn btn-outline" style="background:transparent;color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);">Find work →</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

</body>
</html>
